traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The aarakocra is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The aarakocra has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|ice storm]]
- **5th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Agony
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: Agony can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Agony can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Agony enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Agony that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: One humanoid that Agony can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Agony; Agony then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Agony now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Agony can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Agony ends it as a bonus action, or Agony is turned or forced out by an effect like the [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell. When the possession ends, Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

sb.name: Astral Blight
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: While it has at least 1 hit point, the astral blight sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The blight doesn't require air or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blight makes two Heat-Draining Vine attacks.

actions.name: Heat-Draining Vine
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) radiant damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 3 (1d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. The blight has two vines, each of which can grapple one creature.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Big Momma doesn't require air.

actions.name: Swallowing Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by Big Momma. Big Momma can have one creature swallowed at a time. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Big Momma, and takes 11 (2d10) acid damage at the start of each of Big Momma's turns from the digestive juices in Big Momma's gullet. If Big Momma takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Big Momma must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of Big Momma. If Big Momma dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonus_actions.name: Ray of Fear (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Big Momma's eye emits an invisible, magical ray that targets one creature Big Momma can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Big Momma until the start of Big Momma's next turn.

traits.name: Firearms Knowledge
traits.desc: Krux's mastery of its weapons enables it to ignore the loading property of any firearm.

traits.name: Steady as She Goes
traits.desc: On the deck of a ship, Krux has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone or shove it overboard.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Krux makes two Longsword or Musket attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Musket
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Force Grenade
actions.desc: Krux throws a grenade up to 60 feet, and the grenade explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After Krux throws the grenade, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, Krux has no more grenades to throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Elaina makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or Elaina makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Elaina adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Elaina must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: Fel has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Fel is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). Fel has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|inflict wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Fel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Flapjack
sb.languages: understands Undercommon but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Advanced Telepathy
traits.desc: Flapjack can perceive the content of any telepathic communication used within 60 feet of it, and it can't be surprised by creatures with any form of telepathy.

traits.name: Prone Deficiency
traits.desc: If Flapjack is knocked prone, roll a die. On an odd result, Flapjack lands upside-down and is incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, Flapjack can make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, righting itself and ending the incapacitated condition if it succeeds.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.desc: Flapjack is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as all divination spells.

actions.name: Tendrils
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 2 (1d4) acid damage on a failure or ending the recurring acid damage on a success. A [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]] spell cast on the target also ends the recurring acid damage.

actions.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from Flapjack must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a foul-smelling liquid. A coated creature exudes a horrible stench for 1d4 hours. The coated creature is poisoned as long as the stench lasts, and other creatures are poisoned while with in 5 feet of the coated creature. A creature can remove the stench on itself by using a short rest to bathe in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Flapjack casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]

sb.name: Grimzod Gargenhale
sb.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Explode
traits.desc: When Grimzod is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Grimzod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Grimzod doesn't require air or drink.

actions.name: Energy Drain
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow or vampirate (captain's choice) under the DM's control.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ship Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: A ship upon which Grimzod stands, along with all creatures and objects aboard it, becomes invisible to creatures not aboard the ship. Grimzod must concentrate on this magical effect to maintain it (as if concentrating on a spell), and it lasts for up to 1 hour. The effect ends if Grimzod leaves the ship.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Grimzod halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. Grimzod must be able to see the attacker.

traits.name: Glory
traits.desc: Hastain's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: Hastain can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Hastain wears a talarith.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Hastain makes two Trident attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) force damage if Hastain is wearing its talarith.

actions.name: Chromatic Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) damage of a type chosen by Hastain from the following list: cold, fire, lightning, or radiant.

actions.name: Summon Duplicate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Using its talarith, Hastain summons a duplicate of itself. The duplicate obeys Hastain's commands and uses Hastain's statistics, except it is an unaligned Construct that doesn't have a talarith of its own. The duplicate takes its turn immediately after Hastain. It vanishes after 1 hour or when it is reduced to 0 hit points.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
Hastain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Phantasmal Force|phantasmal force]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|mass suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]]

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Xeleth has advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on itself, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Xeleth wears a suit of elven chain.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Xeleth doesn't require sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Xeleth makes two Scimitar attacks and uses Radiant Beam (if available).

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Beam (3/Day)
actions.desc: A magical beam of radiance flashes out from Xeleth's hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Xeleth casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|mislead]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]]

bonus_actions.name: Starlight Step (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Xeleth magically teleports up to 30 feet, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus_actions.name: Summon Solar Dragon (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Xeleth has a 50 percent chance of magically summoning a young solar dragon. A summoned dragon appears in an unoccupied space that the summoner can see, acts on its own initiative count, and is an ally of its summoner. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

traits.name: Mercane Telepathy
traits.desc: Vocath can communicate telepathically with any other mercane it knows, regardless of the distance between them.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Psi-Imbued Blade

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
